title: sector_split
description: Emitted by the JMT Liftoff Mod plugin when a sector split can be computed between two consecutive gates for a pilot.

sector_index.description: Ordinal of the sector within the pilot's gate sequence

from_gate.description: checkpoint_id of the gate the sector started at

to_gate.description: checkpoint_id of the gate the sector ended at

gate_time_sec.description: Unity Time.time at the closing gate (seconds)
